name: browser
description: 浏览器操作工具（CDP + MOSS 浏览器扩展）：可操作加载了 MOSS 扩展的任意 Chromium 浏览器（Chrome/Edge/Brave 等），也可启动 MOSS 内置 Chrome。MOSS 启动时会校验并自动安装缺失的扩展（保留现有登录态）。首次 action='open' 会新建独立的 MOSS 浏览器窗口：窗口在后台打开、不抢当前窗口焦点，标签仍自动归入「MOSS」标签组；后续 open 复用该窗口。绝不接管用户已有标签页。推荐循环：先 action='status' 查看桥接/实例与安装状态；页面操作前先 action='snapshot' 获取带 ref=eN 的可交互元素树，再用 click/type/press_key/select/hover/scroll/drag 按 ref 操作，页面变化后重新 snapshot；drag 用于滑块/地图/画布等按住拖拽；screenshot 返回截图；tabs 列出 AI 标签页；evaluate 可执行页面 JS（受配置限制）。
description_en: Browser automation tool (CDP + MOSS browser extension): drives any Chromium browser with the MOSS extension installed (Chrome/Edge/Brave etc.), or launches MOSS built-in Chrome. On startup MOSS verifies and installs the extension into detected browsers while preserving existing logins. The first action='open' creates a dedicated MOSS browser window in the background (without stealing focus from the current window); tabs are still grouped under the "MOSS" tab group, and later opens reuse that window. It never takes over existing user tabs. Recommended loop: action='status' to inspect bridge/instances and installer state; before page actions call action='snapshot' to get the accessible element tree with ref=eN, then click/type/press_key/select/hover/scroll/drag by ref, and re-snapshot after page changes. drag performs press-move-release gestures for sliders/maps/canvases. screenshot returns an image; tabs lists AI tabs; evaluate runs page JS (subject to config).

action.description: 操作类型。观察：status/snapshot/screenshot/tabs/console/wait；建页与管理：setup/open/focus/close；页面操作：navigate/click/hover/type/press_key/select/scroll/drag/evaluate。

tab.description: AI 标签页 id（如 t1；来自 open/tabs 的返回）。缺省使用当前 AI 标签页
tab.description_en: AI tab id (e.g. t1; from open/tabs). Defaults to the current AI tab.

browser.description: 浏览器实例选择：auto（缺省）/ builtin / external（或 extension）/ status 返回的实例 id
browser.description_en: Browser instance: auto (default) / builtin / external (or extension) / an instance id from status.

url.description: 要打开的网址（open/navigate）；无协议前缀时自动补 https://
url.description_en: URL to open (open/navigate); https:// is prepended when the scheme is missing.

ref.description: snapshot 返回的元素引用（如 e3），用于 click/hover/type/select/scroll
ref.description_en: Element ref from snapshot (e.g. e3) for click/hover/type/select/scroll.

selector.description: CSS 选择器（ref 的替代定位方式）

x.description: 点击坐标 X（视口像素，click 且无 ref/selector 时使用）
x.description_en: Click X in viewport pixels (used when click has no ref/selector).

y.description: 点击坐标 Y（视口像素）

from_ref.description: 拖动起点元素引用（drag，如 e3）
from_ref.description_en: Drag start element ref (drag, e.g. e3).

from_selector.description: 拖动起点 CSS 选择器（drag）

from_x.description: 拖动起点 X（视口像素，drag 且无 from_ref/from_selector 时使用）
from_x.description_en: Drag start X in viewport pixels (used when drag has no from_ref/from_selector).

from_y.description: 拖动起点 Y（视口像素）
from_y.description_en: Drag start Y in viewport pixels.

to_ref.description: 拖动终点元素引用（drag，如 e5）
to_ref.description_en: Drag end element ref (drag, e.g. e5).

to_selector.description: 拖动终点 CSS 选择器（drag）

to_x.description: 拖动终点 X（视口像素）
to_x.description_en: Drag end X in viewport pixels.

to_y.description: 拖动终点 Y（视口像素）
to_y.description_en: Drag end Y in viewport pixels.

steps.description: 拖动插值步数（drag；缺省 12，越多越接近真实手势）
steps.description_en: Drag interpolation steps (drag; default 12, higher is closer to a real gesture).

duration_ms.description_en: Total drag duration in ms (drag; default 300).

click_count.description_en: Click count for click (default 1; 2 = double click).

replace.description: type 时先全选替换原内容（缺省 false，追加输入）

submit.description: type 后按 Enter 提交

values.description: 下拉框要选中的值/文本（select，可多个）
values.description_en: Option values/texts to select (select, multiple allowed).

delta_y.description: 垂直滚动量（scroll；缺省 600，正数向下）
delta_y.description_en: Vertical scroll delta (scroll; default 600, positive = down).

expression.description: 在页面执行的 JavaScript 表达式（evaluate；支持 await Promise）
expression.description_en: JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page (evaluate; awaits promises).

wait_selector.description: 等待 CSS 选择器出现（wait）
wait_selector.description_en: Wait until this CSS selector appears (wait).

wait_text.description: 等待页面正文包含指定文本（wait）
wait_text.description_en: Wait until page text contains this string (wait).

full_page.description: screenshot 是否截整页（缺省 false，仅视口）
full_page.description_en: Capture the full page in screenshot (default false, viewport only).

clear.description: console 读取后清空缓冲（缺省 false）
clear.description_en: Clear console buffer after reading (default false).

max_nodes.description: snapshot 最大节点数（缺省取工具配置 maxSnapshotNodes）
max_nodes.description_en: Max snapshot nodes (defaults to tool config maxSnapshotNodes).

all.description: tabs 是否列出该浏览器全部标签页（缺省 false，仅 AI 标签页）
all.description_en: List all tabs of the browser (default false, AI tabs only).

timeout_ms.description: 本次操作超时毫秒数（缺省取工具配置 timeoutMs）
timeout_ms.description_en: Operation timeout in ms (defaults to tool config timeoutMs).
